title: A note on Reeb spaces of some explicit real analytic functions
summary: Reeb spaces of smooth functions are fundamental and strong tools in understanding manifolds via smooth functions with mild critical points. They are defined as the natural spaces of all connected components of level sets. They are also important objects in related studies. Realization of graphs as Reeb spaces of smooth functions of certain nice classes is of such studies. In this paper, we present Reeb spaces of explicit real analytic functions which are not finite graphs.
